items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

ctx.x: How did you get into the big band scene? You played with Dorsey and Charlie Shavers.

I got into — I was 19 years old I think if I recall, yeah, 1941. Actually I started in the business basically as an arranger. The piano was a little bit secondary. I bought a book on arranging when I was a kid by Frank Skinner, and I had a band in high school, and another arranger, Frank Comstock was in the same harmony class I was in down there and he and I were friends. And he had a band too. I don’t know whether you’re familiar with Frank, but he did a whole lot of stuff for Les Brown when he was very young,…
